name: Rest & Recovery
content:
RESTING DURING A QUEST

During the Quest phase of play, the party may take one short rest and one long rest per day. The Quest's Keeping may alter the effects of resting (see the Treasure & Keeping section), but these are the default effects:

SHORT REST

At least 1 hour of undisturbed rest is considered a SHORT REST:

  • If you are not Helpless, you recover Endurance equal to your BODY score.

  • Your Speed and Defense are restored to their base.

LONG REST

At least 6 consecutive hours of undisturbed rest is considered a LONG REST:

  • Remove an amount of Injury equal to the cost, in Treasure, of the Quest's Keeping (see the Treasure & Keeping section).

  • Your Endurance is restored to its base, minus your current Injury. If you are Helpless, you instead recover Endurance equal to your BODY score, up to your base minus your current Injury.

  • Your current Speed, Defense and MP are restored to their base.

  • If you have 0 Hope, you regain 1 Hope.

If a long rest is interrupted by one hour or more of activity or any amount of combat, you instead gain the benefits of a short rest.

INTERMEZZO

An Intermezzo (see the Phases of Play section) is another opportunity to rest and recover from the hardships of the questing life. In addition to the broad narrative possibilities of an Intermezzo, there are some specific actions characters may choose to take to restore their strength:

DISTRIBUTE COMPAGNIA

Any Compagnia (see the Quest Mechanics) left over at the end of a Quest may be distributed among those who participated in the Quest. Each point distributed in this way removes 1 Shadow or clears 1 Condition for the recipient. Players should reach consensus about how to distribute the points before doing so.

TREAT INJURIES

For each day of Intermezzo, remove an amount of Injury equal to the cost, in Treasure, of your Keeping.

STRENGTHEN COMPAGNIA

If you and another player character spend the entire Intermezzo in one another's company, choose two effects:

  • You each gain 1 Hope.

  • You each remove 1 Shadow.

  • You each clear one Condition.

  • The next time both characters embark on a Quest together, the Quest starts with 1 additional Compagnia.

Describe how you spend your time together and how it strengthens your bond.

CLEAR CONDITIONS

The narrative requirements for clearing Conditions during an Intermezzo are the same as during a Quest, but in some situations it may be wise to deal with those emotions in a more controlled environment than during a Quest. See Conditions.

GAINFUL EMPLOYMENT

If you perform work for wages during an Intermezzo, you may either upgrade your Keeping by one tier for the duration of the Intermezzo or gain 1 Treasure at the end of each month (see the Treasure & Keeping section).
